strings.en: Is that... the Nadesico's new equipment?
That's right! It's the Y Unit.
It was originally designed for one of Nergal's new battleships...
but with all the recent chaos, building new battleships is out of the question,
so they hurriedly refitted it for the Nadesico.
Huh, looks pretty good.
So how does the Nadesico power up once this thing's attached?
It better not be just for show.
Allow me to explain!
First, the phase transition engines double from the current two to four.
Simply put, the number of generators is doubled.
In short, it can stabilize and strengthen the Distortion Field.
Yes... And for armaments, in addition to the current Gravity Blast,
it can fire an even stronger Phase Transition Cannon.
In other words, all of the Nadesico's capabilities get a power-up.
That's insane! They were built to different specs to begin with!
But it seems like it'll be fine.
Besides, aren't all of Londo Bell's robots like that?
That's no laughing matter.
What? ...That's it?
"That's it"!? Output, weapons, defense! How else would it power up!?
Like, combining with that thing turns the Nadesico into a giant robot...
Ooh, I like that! One command from me, and the Nadesico goes ka-boom...
I think the mess hall would end up in serious trouble.
Forget that, Captain, what happened with Minato and Meg's punishment?
And the Jovian Lizards... no, the Jovians... What'll you do, Yurika?
As for Haruka and Reinard, partly for appearances with the Federation,
they're confined to quarters for now... As for the Jovians,
I haven't heard anything official yet...
...Our mission... hasn't changed at all.
What!? Hasn't changed at all...?
What's that supposed to mean!?
You mean to keep on killing those people!? Captain!?
Megumi! Minato!
Hey there, sorry for barging in.
Now that we're all together, I thought I'd bring along
the people who know the situation best...
Banjo. ...But how did you...?
The locks on Megumi's and Haruka's quarters have been released.
Hey, hey, somebody managed to fool Omoikane?
No one fooled anything. I am the commander of Londo Bell, after all.
I have at least that much authority.
So this is the Nadesico's bridge...
It seems more livable than a Federation ship, too.
Nice to meet you, everyone.
Well now... Captain Bright and the members of Londo Bell,
all here together...
We've never talked face to face, so I invited them!
The Nadesico's mess hall is famous for its tasty food!
I look forward to it... but first, our concerns. I couldn't eat a bite.
To think they would actually stop the colony.
And things on the surface are starting to settle... The time is right.
You called for me, Lady Haman?
The Federation is in chaos from the alien invasion.
Though we've been affected in no small way, too.
Mashymre, lead the new models and bring down Londo Bell.
Yes, ma'am! ...Lady Haman, what are your thoughts on the surface?
I could send men from my unit, and we could hit the Federation's main forces
on the surface and in space at once. That might prove amusing.
Fear not. I've already sent a unit to Jaburo. Glemy's.
Besides... there's an interesting one among the Titans' survivors.
The Titans...? No, more importantly, Glemy Toto...!?
Lady Haman, forgive my impertinence, but that man is...
...I know.
Pardon? Then why...?
I want to see it. How that one will move...
You need only devote all your strength to defeating Londo Bell...
I'm counting on you, Mashymre.
I'm unworthy of such words...!
on my honor as Mashymre Cello,
I will not fail to meet your expectations, Lady Haman.
...Yes, Glemy left someone behind... Take that one with you as well.
Huh? No, I don't need that one's help, I can manage alone...
Just to be safe.
...Y-yes, understood...
(A Newtype squad... Frankly, I don't like it...)
"Nothing's changed"... So in the end, that means we're going to war
with the people from Jupiter, doesn't it!?
That's right! How could you... They were Earth people too, you know?
Minato, Megumi, please don't get so worked up...
...But... so what if they were human too!
It doesn't change the fact that they attacked the people on Mars!
So just because they're human... we forgive them for killing!?
It's true, just as you heard from Major Tsukumo Shiratori...
these people who call themselves Jovians were originally from Earth.
We've received a top-secret report as well.
In the space colony autonomy disputes at the start of the Universal Century,
they were driven out of the Earth Sphere by the Federation, it seems.
Colonies, the moon, Mars... They were driven out time after time, and
a media blackout buried all of it...
I looked into it on my end, too.
Around the same time... several large emigrant fleets, to avoid chaos,
secretly set off for deep space.
Apparently they used that as cover to hush up the Jovian Alliance, too...
That's just too cruel...
Why does it have to turn into a war...?
Hm? Captain Misumaru never said anything about going to war, did she?
Huh? ...But she said nothing would change...
Captain Misumaru. Has the Nadesico been actively waging war...?
No. With the Jovian Liz... the Jovians' drones, when there's no choice,
we do take them out... but basically we only intercept.
...Well, sometimes we do go a little overboard.
Now that you mention it... that's true...
Which is a bit of a problem for a battleship...
It's the same for us. Basically, at least.
Then...!?
We brush off the sparks that fall on us.
But we won't start an all-out war with a group we can negotiate with.
So, with the people from Jupiter too...
That's right. Otherwise, Londo Bell and the Gandor Team
would never have drawn so many civilian allies.
Our current mission isn't them.
Besides, much about the situation on Jupiter is still unclear.
All we can do is pray they don't make the first move.
That's how it is. So, Meg, Minato, won't you please relax?
...I guess... you're right...
Realistically, this is probably the best we can do...
Akito... Mr. Shiratori said he loves Gekiganger...
He said on Jupiter, Gekiganger is their holy scripture...
Geki... ganger...?
A robot anime from long ago, in an old-fashioned style.
Technology's advanced so far that civilians can now build such robots.
(I'll just have to sit back and watch... until things develop, anyway.)
In any case, there's still a lot we don't know about the Jovian forces.
The Nadesico will continue to join us in our current operations.
Is that all right, Captain Misumaru?
Yes, sir! We look forward to working with you again! ...Ah!!
Hm?
Is it... something important? Captain, if there's anything I can do...
Oh, no... About the mess hall earlier, I forgot to say
that I recommend the Mars Bowl.
...Idiot...
Can we make it...!?
Is it true!? Iron Mask is...!
...Yeah, at Frontier Colony... they're going to run an experiment...!
An experiment... with those things called Bugs...
I don't really know much about it...
But... I do know we absolutely can't let them do it...!
...Can we do it... on our own?
I don't know... But I heard the only Federation unit
that can move right now is Londo Bell!
With this many problems happening at once, there's no telling when
they'll make it to Frontier Colony...
At worst... it'll be just us...!?
...So, Cecily.
Don't push yourself. If things get hopeless, pull out.
If you keep running, you won't die.
...I won't... run. No, I mustn't run.
Let's hurry, Seabook.
I see... So there are difficult problems among Earthlings as well...
No kidding. This is no time for humans to be squabbling with each other...
Geez, you say that so often it's practically your catchphrase...
And yet this is no time for humans to be fighting each other...
No matter how often we say it, it doesn't help...
but as people of Earth, it's shameful.
Yeah... Oh, Captain Bright, welcome back.
Brother, how were the Nadesico people...?
Well... maybe not completely,
but it seems they managed to sort out their feelings.
They may not look it, but the Nadesico's crew
is a group of specialists gathered from all over the world...
Huh... Looks can be deceiving...
Well, we're not really in a position to talk, are we?
No doubt.
So, what do we do now?
We stopped the colony from falling, and we protected this place...
Yes... About that...
we've learned something serious about the plant planet.
S-something serious...!?
You know it's been gradually approaching Earth, right?
Its speed... is increasing at an accelerating rate...!
Then... it'll reach Earth soon!?
Shapiro... Don't tell me he's...!
First a colony, now an asteroid. Earth sure never runs short of events.
This is no time to be impressed!
Bright, is there any way to stop it!?
There's... one thing we could try.
Quit stalling, what is it, Captain?
We snipe... the planet's core.
Ridiculous! Even with all units firing at once, that mass...
...No, Captain. We use the colony laser...!
A colony... laser...!?
Ah! You don't mean...
...Gryps II, then.
The one used in the war against the Titans...!?
Yes, it should still be usable... With that, we have a chance...!
What a reckless plan... But better than doing nothing, I guess.
So that means... we aim that colony laser at the asteroid, and...
Boom! ...If only it were that easy...
If only he... if only Shapiro would let things go that smoothly...
Still, you've gotta be kidding me!?
Why does every problem have to pop up all at once!?
But... it started moving as if on cue.
Most likely... until now, they were just watching.
Now that the colony drop has been averted, for the enemy, this
should be their last chance to break the stalemate...!
Brother... then...
Gyandlar will probably make their move too.
(That mystery enemy... and that little miss too... They might try something...
I've got a bad feeling about this...)
What Leina told me... about the Mutron worries me too...
I hope Gyandlar and the Bunker don't make a move...
Captain!
Lieutenant? Has something happened!?
...Enemies are gathering... at the Frontier I colony and Konpeito...!
What...!
It's the endgame here in more ways than one... It's all coming at once...!
We set out at once!
But what about resupply!?
It can't be helped. We can't spare the time.
If we resupply and arrive late when it counts, it defeats the purpose.
Still, running out of gas there would be a problem too.
I'll have my assistant bring supplies after us.
Beauty should do, I think.
Got it. Just tell me the rendezvous point later.
You already slipped up with that Jovian Alliance guy, so get it right.
So did you, Reika!
Either way, that's the only plan we've got.
All right, the Ra Cailum is departing Von Braun! Notify the Nadesico!
